title: Discography
description: One artist's complete catalogue. One file per artist, loaded at runtime from src/assets/data/{id}.json.

Slug.title: Slug
Slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. Unique within its collection in a single artist file.

ArtistId.title: ArtistId
ArtistId.description: Artist slug. Must equal the filename stem and the matching index.json entry id.

SongId.title: SongId
SongId.description: Song slug, unique within the file. Titles that collide are disambiguated with a year suffix, for example closer-2004 and closer-2025.

ReleaseType.title: ReleaseType
ReleaseType.description: Shared vocabulary for albums[].type and songs[].type.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: How well verified this record is. See docs/SCHEMA.md for what each level means.

aliases.description: Other names the act has recorded under. Empty array if none.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date this file was last revised.

scopeNotes.description: What this dataset includes and excludes. Shown on the artist page.

Era.title: Era
Era.description: A named period in the artist's history. Songs and albums reference an era by id.

Album.title: Album
Album.description: Any release a song can appear on: studio albums, editions, compilations, soundtracks, demo sets.

title.description: Exact title. Every string in songs[].albums must match one of these exactly.

released.description: Full ISO 8601 release date. Omit the key entirely when only the year is known.

year.description: Release year, or null for material that was never released.

albums.description: Always an array, even for a single album. Empty for non-album singles and unreleased material. Each entry must match an albums[].title exactly.

year.description: Year of FIRST commercial release, which may precede the parent album's year. Null when never released.

features.description: Guest artists credited on the release. Empty array if none.

originalArtist.description: Must be null when isCover is false. May be null for a cover whose original performer is not recorded.

notes.description: Free text. Empty string when there is nothing to say.
